findings.expected: At the successful return, a fresh check must show both the port free and the target launchd label absent at the same time; otherwise wait until the deadline or fail.
findings.minimal_repair: Evaluate both live predicates on each iteration and return 0 only when that iteration observes both true. Transition logging can remember previous observations, but those cached flags must not determine readiness. Preserve the bounded deadline and one-retry limit.
findings.observed: ld_wait_unloaded sets pf=1 and la=1 once and never rechecks a condition after it was seen true. It can return 0 when port 3001 was free in an earlier poll but is occupied at the moment the label disappears, or vice versa. Replaying the exact function with mocked checks produced wait_exit=0 while current_port_free=no. W1 and the guarded W3 retry both rely on this function to prove simultaneous readiness.

regression_proof.description: Extract the contract function and mock a port that is free on poll one then occupied when the label disappears on poll two. It must not return success; also retain normal simultaneous-success and deadline controls.

findings.expected: The contract must specify how every W1-W3 and rollback transition and outcome named in the LOGGING manual check is recorded with a UTC timestamp and no secrets, including failure paths.
findings.minimal_repair: Add explicit ld_log calls or a bounded owner-run wrapper for the missing events in the W1-W3 and rollback rows. Record command exit statuses, /login status, PID/cwd and rollback outcome without logging credentials. Rehearse the log structure on a throwaway label and port, including a failed first bootstrap and rollback path.
findings.observed: The helper logs port-free, label-absent, bootstrap exit and retry decisions. The W1-W3 and rollback rows do not instruct the operator or a script to write the other required events to <TS>/window-transitions.log: bootout issued and its outcome, W2 plist installation, /login result, serving PID/cwd, rollback bootout/restore/bootstrap and final health. The assertion that every transition is logged therefore has no executable coverage for these events.

regression_proof.description: Walk the documented normal, retry and rollback paths and inspect the scratch transition log for timestamped bootout, plist install, bootstrap attempts, /login, PID/cwd and rollback restore/health entries. No production label is used.

notes: Exact frozen SHA/tree, single allowed document change, diff --check and secret-pattern scan verified. Coordinator verify OK. Mocked only local helper predicates; no production service or plist contact.
